title: Synthesis and structure of the mercury hydride compound, [Tism                     <sup>                       Pr                       <sup>i</sup>                       Benz                     </sup>                     ]HgH: a complete series of congeneric terminal hydride compounds of zinc, cadmium and mercury
abstract: The terminal mercury hydride compound, [Tism                                            Pr                       i                       Benz                                          ]HgH, which features the tris[(1-isopropylbenzimidazol-2-yl)dimethylsilyl]methyl ligand, has been synthesized                     via                     the reaction of the triphenylsiloxide compound, [Tism                                            Pr                       i                       Benz                                          ]HgOSiPh                     3                     , with PhSiH                     3                     .
